state:
- Novelty rests on approved-prodrug status rather than demonstrated separation from prior work. Check existing leflunomide/teriflunomide AML studies and identify the genuinely new residual-state hypothesis.
- ROS-high is not synonymous with oxidative-metabolism dependence, and the design lacks a clear test of preferential residual-state sensitivity. Measure respiration/dependency directly and compare matched pretreatment and post-cytarabine populations while controlling for proliferation.
- Failed uridine rescue and wild-type DHODH overexpression do not conclusively establish off-target action. Validate uridine salvage competence and a resistance-conferring DHODH rescue construct before treating these outcomes as mechanistic falsifiers.
